privacy: Your workbook stays in this browser. Nothing is uploaded.
invalid: Choose a readable XLSX workbook. The file may be damaged or contain invalid cell data.
protected: Encrypted Excel files cannot be converted. Save an unencrypted XLSX copy and try again.
unsupported: This workbook uses unsupported Excel features or contains values that cannot be represented in ODS. Save a simpler copy in your spreadsheet application.
resource: This workbook needs more memory than this browser can provide. Close other tabs or try another device.
engineUnavailable: The converter could not load. Check your connection and try again.
empty: This worksheet has no stored cell data.
previewNote: This window shows up to 20 rows and 8 columns. The download includes all imported worksheets and cells.
invalidAddress: Enter a cell address within this worksheet’s used range, such as A1.
missingCaches: Some formulas have no saved result. Their cells remain blank in the ODS file; formula expressions are not exported.
preserved: Worksheet names and order, empty and hidden worksheets, cell positions, text, numbers, booleans, dates, and saved formula results are included.
limitations: Formulas become their saved values; expressions are not retained or recalculated. Styles, merged-cell layout, charts, images, comments, links, macros, and workbook settings are not preserved. Error results become text. Check the output before relying on it.
previewLimits: Dates use a standard date/time format and respect the workbook’s date system. Time-only values and durations use a basic duration format. Percentages and currency retain their number without the original formatting or currency label. Very hidden sheets become ordinary hidden sheets.
